name: lopper
description: Compaction that prunes instead of summarizing: old tool output is trimmed, every word you and Claude wrote stays verbatim. Local, instant, no network.

threshold.title: Threshold (tokens)
threshold.description: Past this many tokens of context, lopper prunes on its own at the end of a turn (at most 60% of the model's window).

target.title: Target (tokens)
target.description: Where pruning aims to land; above it lopper runs a tighter pass (at most 60% of the threshold).

recentTokens.title: Recent tokens kept whole
recentTokens.description: The newest tokens of the conversation, where tool results are never trimmed.

auto.title: Automatic pruning
auto.description: When off, lopper only acts on /compact and at Claude Code's own limit.

language.title: Language of lopper's messages
language.description: en or it. Notes written for the model are always in English.
